in_sanskrit.name: दिनश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules over days or a day

in_marathi.name: Dinash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Day
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dinash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dinash is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dina' meaning day and 'as' meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the god of the day or the ruler of the day.
